name: plate_hx_thermal_resistances
title: Single-phase plate heat exchanger: thermal-resistance model (Martin)
summary: Heat-transfer coefficient, thermal resistance and pressure drop of a chevron-type plate heat exchanger on the single-phase side, from the plate geometry with Martin's 1996 correlation; water properties from the built-in calls, ethylene-glycol brine from BRINEPROP2 (ULiège BrineProp) on the alternate $IF branch.
fluids: EG brine (BrineProp2, not a CoolProp fluid)
language_features: expression as CALL output argument (EG branch)
